description: Redux reducer module for managing channel view states in Mattermost web application, including post visibility, last viewed times, loading states, focused posts, mobile view, unread channels, post timestamps, toast notifications, and prefetch status.

methods.name: postVisibility
methods.description: Reducer handling post visibility per channel, updating visible post chunks based on actions.

methods.name: lastChannelViewTime
methods.description: Reducer tracking the last time each channel was viewed.

methods.name: loadingPosts
methods.description: Reducer managing loading state of posts per channel.

methods.name: focusedPostId
methods.description: Reducer storing the ID of the currently focused post.

methods.name: mobileView
methods.description: Reducer indicating whether the mobile view is active.

methods.name: lastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Reducer tracking if the current channel was unread and had mentions when switched.

methods.name: lastGetPosts
methods.description: Reducer recording the last fetch time for posts in each channel.

methods.name: toastStatus
methods.description: Reducer managing the status of toast notifications.

methods.name: channelPrefetchStatus
methods.description: Reducer tracking prefetch status for channel posts.
